messages.subject: gbm3 and OpenMP on Mac
messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to help a Mac-using colleague use gbm3, but the Mac clang compiler doesn't seem to support openmp. Any of you successfully compile gbm3 on a Mac? I don't know my way around a Mac and am not sure where to point him. Not even sure how to tell him to try gcc instead, etc.

Greg

There's instructions on getting openmp to work on macos R at:

http://thecoatlessprofessor.com/programming/openmp-in-r-on-os-x/

I keep asking the world to buy me a Mac so I can test this out, but no luck yet. :-)

pdm
